review_note: Probit and cloglog, animal(A, Ainv, pedigree) plus spatial(coords), each with its own SD formula (6 rows, all fitted: 2 links x 3 animal inputs). The oracle is a base-R dense Laplace with a Henderson tabular A from an inbred pedigree (diag 1.25) and a hand-built exp(-d/median)+1e-6 I spatial kernel, none from drmTMB helpers. The pedigree fit is checked against that independent A, which closes the earlier helper-under-test gap. logLik tolerance is 1e-4. Five emulated bugs (swapped selector coefficient sets, reversed SDs, cov2cor(A), A by position, coordinates by position) must each move the oracle by more than 0.1, and they pass. Manifest 7/7 hashes match current files, test and console hashes match, and the rerun shows 82 expectations, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips. Narrow claim: likelihood agreement at the fitted parameters on one seed per link. Does NOT establish: interval calibration or coverage, Julia parity, logit rows, recovery or accuracy, or other families, links or providers.
